title: AI Developer Advocate (f/m/d)
description: Even great products require remarkable presentations to win on the digital shelf. CELUM solves this challenge with its unique SaaS Content Supply Chain Management Platform. CELUM’s software enables Marketing, Brand, and Product teams to build engaging experiences by creating, approving, managing, and distributing content across all channels - and understanding its impact. We make content work! As an AI Developer Advocate, you turn AI from a buzzword into something teams actually use (and love). You bring hands-on AI into everyday workflows, build practical solutions, and help shape how AI becomes a natural part of how we build software at CELUM. Together with our cross-functional teams, you turn ideas into working AI solutions that teams actually use.
requirements: 3+ years of experience in software engineering, AI development, or a related field. Hands-on experience with AI technologies such as LLMs, agents, or AI APIs (e.g. OpenAI, Azure AI) Strong programming skills. Experience with APIs, system integration, and data pipelines. Practical experience applying AI across development workflows (coding, testing, automation, documentation). Ability to turn AI concepts into scalable, real-world solutions. Strong problem-solving mindset with a hands-on approach. Excellent communication and collaboration skills. Curiosity and enthusiasm for experimenting with new tools and technologies. Fluent in English; German is a plus
responsibilities: Drive hands-on AI adoption by designing and delivering practical AI solutions such as LLM-based applications, agents, and data pipelines, and establishing reusable best practices across teams. Enable engineering teams to effectively apply AI in their daily work, supporting use cases across coding, testing, documentation, and decision-making, and acting as a go-to expert for integration challenges. Optimize the software development lifecycle by introducing AI-driven improvements and establishing guardrails, patterns, and toolchains to ensure secure, scalable, and consistent usage. Translate AI strategy into execution by turning objectives into concrete initiatives, experiments, and measurable outcomes while driving adoption across teams. Support organizational transformation towards AI-driven ways of working, promoting a data- and AI-first mindset and guiding teams through evolving workflows and processes. Build and maintain reusable frameworks, templates, and reference architectures while ensuring alignment with security, compliance, and responsible AI practices. Continuously evaluate new AI capabilities, run experiments, and feed learnings back into product and engineering to drive ongoing improvement.
benefits: An annual salary of at least EUR 80,000 if all requirements are met (higher salary is possible if requirements are exceeded). Benefit from an annual subsidy of up to 461 EUR for public transportation (Wiener Linien, Linz AG, ÖBB, etc.) to make your commute to work environmentally friendly and smooth. Come to our office in the heart of Vienna with excellent public transport connections (U1 and U4). Use our pool cars and e-scooters for private purposes as well. Stay fit and have fun with our extensive fitness offers and monthly yoga classes. Experience a flexible work environment with a fixed workspace and up to 3 days of home office (presence day´s are Tuesday and Wednesday). Become part of the CELUMian community where we have each other's backs and celebrate together at regular events or our Workation. Bring your sense of humor! We have fun :-) most of the time...at least a little bit...no, seriously, we are funny. We swear!

title: Rechtsanwaltsanwärter:innen Public Law
description: We are looking for committed and highly qualified associates (f/m/x) with a special interest in public law and foreign direct investment to support our team in Vienna.
requirements: You will have completed your Austrian legal studies with above-average results and have excellent English and German skills. You have an entrepreneurial mindset, attention to detail, and dedication to quality legal advice, as well as strong analytical skills and a genuine interest in regulatory, policy and geopolitical developments. Experience abroad or specialized knowledge in these areas (e.g., through an LL.M., dissertation, internships, university / research assistant roles, or law firm experience) is advantageous but not a must.
responsibilities: In your future position, you will advise national and international clients on a wide range of questions, with a focus on: Regulatory Public Law: Offering expert advice on leading national and international clients on a broad range of public and regulatory law matters with focus on cutting-edge topics including product regulation such as food & beverages, pharmaceuticals, medical devices, mobility, digitalisation and energy law. Foreign Direct Investment: As part of our team, you will work at the forefront of one of the most dynamic and fast-evolving areas of international law and advise a high-profile client base - including multinational corporates, private equity funds, sovereign wealth funds and other international investors - on FDI control in complex, sensitive and multi-jurisdictional projects and transactions. Your work will include: Delivering ad hoc advice on complex and strategic regulatory public law matters, frequently in the context of upcoming legislative changes and evolving legal frameworks. Supporting regulatory public law aspects of transactions across highly and less regulated industries, including trade law as well as law advice in respect of industrial facilities, water law and other sector-specific regulatory requirements. Preparing written submissions and support litigation strategy in administrative court proceedings, and advise on product recalls and compliance with applicable product regulatory regimes. Advising clients on FDI filing requirements and investment screening processes under the Austrian Investment Control Act (Investitionskontrollgesetz). Preparing and managing investment control applications in highly sensitive sectors, including defence, energy infrastructure, data centres, telecommunications, healthcare, and artificial intelligence. Coordinating FDI filings across multiple jurisdictions to secure regulatory approvals for cross-border M&A transactions - working hand in hand with Freshfields colleagues in London, Brussels, Berlin, Paris, Washington and beyond. Representing clients in administrative proceedings before the Federal Ministry for Economy, Labour and Tourism as well as representing and assisting clients in national and EU proceedings, including before higher administrative and constitutional courts. Monitoring and analysing legislative developments in the regulatory public law and foreign direct investment (FDI) sector at the Austrian and EU levels.
benefits: Be part of a market-leading internationally integrated team operating at the forefront of Austrian public law and FDI control. Work in a dynamic, international environment with direct access to Freshfields' global network of specialists. You will gain early responsibility and direct client exposure in high-profile matters. Benefit from outstanding learning and development opportunities tailored to your growth (including internal bar exam preparation courses and soft law skills trainings). As additional benefits, we also provide an annual public transport pass, access to an on-site gym, regular networking events, and well-being programs.Did we get you interested? Then get in touch with us – we are looking forward to receiving your online-application: austria.freshfields.com/opportunities. Note: according to §9 GlBG: There is no collective agreement or legal minimum salary. The intended minimum basis for the salary arrangement (with the possibility of additional payment) is an annual salary (gross, all-in, 14 instalments) in the amount of 61,000 EUR.

title: Legal Counsel
description: Established in March 2018, Bybit is one of the fastest growing cryptocurrency derivatives exchanges, with more than 70 million registered users. We offer a professional platform where crypto traders can find an ultra-fast matching engine, excellent customer service and multilingual community support. We provide innovative online spot and derivatives trading services, mining and staking products, as well as API support, to retail and institutional clients around the world, and strive to be the most reliable exchange for the emerging digital asset class. Our core values define us. We listen, care, and improve to create a faster, fairer, and more humane trading environment for our users. Our innovative, highly advanced, user-friendly platform has been designed from the ground-up using best-in-class infrastructure to provide our users with the industry's safest, fastest, fairest, and most transparent trading experience. Built on customer-centric values, we endeavour to provide a professional, 24/7 multi-language customer support to help in a timely manner. As of today, Bybit is one of the most trusted, reliable, and transparent cryptocurrency derivatives platforms in the space.
requirements: A law degree (LLB, JD, Mag. iur., LL.M., or equivalent) Minimum of 3 years of legal experience, preferably within an in-house legal team, regulatory authority, or law firm. Strong understanding of Austrian and EU laws relating to international contract law, commercial law, and regulatory compliance. Experience handling official legal requests such as court orders, or administrative inquiries. Meticulous attention to detail, with strong organizational and documentation skills. Excellent written and verbal communication skills in both German and English. Able to work independently in a fast-paced, regulated environment with high integrity and discretion. This position is based in Austria, Vienna
responsibilities: Draft, review, and negotiate a broad range of contracts, including but not limited to institutional agreements, vendor contracts, NDAs, service agreements, technology and licensing arrangements, and partnership MOUs. Own the end-to-end contract lifecycle process, from contract intake, redlining, approval workflows, execution, and archiving, to renewal and termination management. Act as the point of contact for internal business units (e.g., procurement, operations, tech, finance) to provide clear and timely legal support during commercial negotiations. Ensure all contracts comply with applicable laws, internal policies, and corporate governance requirements. Coordinate with external counsel as necessary for complex negotiations or multi-jurisdictional matters. Develop and maintain a centralized contract management system to monitor key obligations, renewal deadlines, and risk triggers. Proactively identify legal and commercial risks in contracts and recommend mitigations. Support the development and continuous improvement of templates, playbooks, and contracting processes to increase efficiency and consistency. Provide training or guidance to relevant teams on contract terms and legal risk considerations.
